title: Reconstruct itinerary
statementMd:
Given airline tickets `[from, to]`, reconstruct the itinerary starting at `"JFK"` that uses every ticket once, and is lexicographically smallest among valid ones. Return the list of airports.

**Example:** `find_itinerary([["MUC", "LHR"], ["JFK", "MUC"], ["SFO", "SJC"], ["LHR", "S…)` returns `["JFK", "MUC", "LHR", "SFO", "SJC"]`.
